title: docs(automation): a start-less flow is refused at the save and answers 404 at the trigger, not 422
body:
Fixes #32288

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:触发表与客户端注释不再承诺「已存储的无 start 流程触发时回 422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE」,改写为:保存时 400,已存储行不挂载、触发回 404。
- 为什么改:PR #32273 之后没有任何入口能让引擎回这个 422,文档教的是已不存在的路径。
- 风险与回滚:纯文字(含 @objectstack/client 的注释,patch);不动任何联合类型、台账或代码行为;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 的触发状态表两行(404 行与 FLOW_NO_START_NODE 行)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "FLOW_NO_START_NODE" -- content/docs/api packages/client/src/index.ts`,预期只剩 client-sdk 之外无「触发时 422」的承诺。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `flows.mdx`: the `404` row now says a stored flow with no `start` node is never armed and answers there; the `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE` row stays as a defensive exit no door reaches today and names the save-time `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and the `registration: refused` read.
- `plugin-endpoints.mdx`, `declarative-endpoints.mdx`: the `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE` item is dropped from the list of statuses a caller meets; the `404` item names the stored start-less flow.
- `client-sdk.mdx`: `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` dropped from the two caller-meets lists.
- `packages/client/src/index.ts`: the `automation.trigger` / `execute` / scoped `execute` docblocks, prose only.
- `.changeset/32288-flow-no-start-docs.md`: patch, `@objectstack/client`.
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (the `flow` action row) and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx` (the `type: 'flow'` row): the same rewrite, added in rework round 1 after the claim was widened (card comment, seat amendment).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`: three route docblocks; `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: the comment above the `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` exit; `packages/services/service-automation/README.md`: one line. Comments and prose only.
- `.changeset/32288-flow-no-start-docs-runtime.md`: patch, `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/service-automation`.
- Not touched, by the card's fence: `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` in every union, ledger and client type (keep-or-retire is an open ruling).

## Tests

Doc-only diff; no test or ablation owed.

## Acceptance notes

- The places first listed here as left (`actions.mdx`, `http-protocol.mdx`, the runtime route docblocks, the service-automation README and `execute()` comment) were added to this PR in rework round 1; none is left.
- The `validateStartNode` refusal text is unchanged: it explains why the flow is refused (every run of it would fail), and tests pin it.
